title: New: the thread while Trillion opens
summary: While Trillion opens, on the web, your iPhone, your Mac and in Chrome, the red thread from gettrillion.ai plays with a quote that changes every time, then melts away the moment Trillion is ready.

payload.title: A thread while it opens
payload.body: Each time Trillion opens, the needle draws its red thread all over the page, pulls it in until it bunches up, pulls it straight and sets off again, with a different quote in the middle. When your workspace is ready it melts away through a soft wash of colour. It is the same on the web, your iPhone, your Mac and the Chrome extension, and it only shows while Trillion is really opening.
